summary:
Snowflake 上季 EPS 0.32 美元超預期近18%、營收 12.8 億美元，獲利能力一度改善。
• EPS 0.32 美元，超預期 17.78%，獲利表現亮眼
• 營收 12.8 億美元，規模持續擴大
• 資料雲與 AI 工作負載帶動消費型營收
• 大型客戶數穩步成長
ai_view:
訊號正向但須留意持續性：本季 EPS 大幅超預期顯示獲利槓桿浮現，惟結合下一季轉虧可見利潤率波動劇烈。短期財報利多有助情緒，中期應聚焦消費型營收的可預測性、NRR 趨勢與營業利潤率能否穩定走升，避免單季亮眼誤導。估值無本益比參考，市場主要以營收倍數與成長品質定價。

需留意：獲利波動大，後續季度未能維持（參見下季轉虧）；競爭與價格壓力持續；本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限

summary_en:
Snowflake beat EPS at $0.32 by nearly 18% on $1.28B revenue, showing a period of improving profitability.
• EPS of $0.32 beat by 17.78%, a strong profitability showing
• Revenue of $1.28B with continued scale expansion
• Data cloud and AI workloads drive consumption revenue
• Steady growth in large-customer count

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive but watch sustainability: the large EPS beat shows operating leverage emerging, yet the subsequent quarter's loss reveals significant margin volatility. Near term the beat supports sentiment; mid term, focus on the predictability of consumption revenue, NRR trends and whether operating margin steadily improves rather than relying on one strong quarter. With no P/E, the market prices on revenue multiples and growth quality.

Watch：Earnings are volatile and not sustained in the following quarter; Ongoing competition and pricing pressure; Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 17.78%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
